'''''Heberdenia excelsa''''' is a species of [[plant]] in the family [[Primulaceae]]. It is found in the [[Macaronesian]] archipelagoes of [[Madeira]] and the [[Canary Islands]].<ref name="iucn status 17 November 2021" /> It is threatened by [[habitat loss]].
